name: Tajaajila dhaabbataa Waaldaa keenyaa.
description_om:
Dilbata ganama saatii 12:45 hanga 04:30.
Facaasaa/Kibxata sagaantaa fayyinaa fi dadamaqiinsaa hafuura qulqulluutiif kadhatamu ganama saatii 02:30 - 05:30 fi galgala saatii 08:00 - 11:00.
Sagaantaan dargaggootaa Roobii 11:00 - 12:30.
Jimaata halkan saatii 01:30 - 05:00'tti sagantaa barumsaafi waaqeffannaati.
description_am:
እሁድ ጠዋት ከ12:45 እስከ 04:30 — የአምልኮ አገልግሎት።

ማክሰኞ ጠዋት ከ02:30 እስከ 05:30፣ እንዲሁም ምሽት ከ08:00 እስከ 11:00 — የመዳን፣ የመንፈስ ቅዱስ መነቃቃትና የጸሎት ፕሮግራም።

ረቡዕ ከ11:00 እስከ 12:30 — የወጣቶች ፕሮግራም።

አርብ ሌሊት ከ01:30 እስከ 05:00 — የትምህርትና የአምልኮ ፕሮግራም።
description_en:
Sunday: 12:45 AM to 4:30 AM — Worship Service.

Tuesday: 2:30 AM to 5:30 AM, and 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM — Salvation, Holy Spirit Revival, and Prayer Program.

Wednesday: 11:00 AM to 12:30 PM — Youth Program.

Friday: 1:30 AM to 5:00 AM — Bible Teaching and Worship Program.
